Stops crawling at page budget limit

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_pages' => 3, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
